name: Hezbollah, l'enquête interdite
summary: It's widely recognized as a terrorist organization, responsible for many atrocities including the Beirut port blast and destabilization of Lebanon. But 42 years on, the ‘Party of God', remains stronger than ever. It has transformed itself from a small paramilitary group backed by Iran into an omnipotent political party with the largest private army in the world. A 'state within a state', whose extensive charity network ensures the popular support of the Shiite community while its military wing attempts to redraw the borders of the region and erase Israel from the map.

previousepisode.name: Au nom de la raison d'Etat

name: Checo Pérez: ¡No te rindas, cabr#n!
summary: Checo embarks on the 2023 Formula 1 season under immense pressure. With the best car on the grid, his sights are set on becoming the world champion. Following a winning streak on the street circuits of Baku and Jeddah, a devastating accident in Monaco jeopardizes his entire season. Faced with this setback, Checo must prove his place among the elite, proving to the world that he will never give up.

name: Let's Take It Outside
summary: Misty Wells goes from the woods to the water for whitetail and alligator hunting, tarpon, grouper and marlin fishing, shark diving, whitewater rafting and more.

summary: Paul LeRoux ran a global criminal empire from his penthouse in the Philippines and became the world's most prolific yet least-known crime boss.

name: La Voz Ausente
summary: When his older brother is found dead, apparently by suicide, the renowned psychoanalyst Pablo Rouviot is the only one convinced that it is a murder. With the assistance of Officer Cecilia Bermúdez as his sole ally, Pablo takes on the investigation, uncovering a much larger scheme with a serial killer at its core.

name: Friday Night Live with Ben Leo
summary: Join Ben for the biggest stories and debates of the week with a panel of top politicians, comedians and commentators.

name: Ben Leo Tonight
summary: Join Ben for two hours of lively debate and news making interviews. Top guests tackle the big issues of the day with Ben's fresh take on every story.

name: Corridors of Power: Should America Police the World?
summary: No easy answers? Decision-makers from Kissinger to Rice revisit how the US responded to conflicts from Rwanda to Iraq. Faced with human suffering - who has responsibility to act?

summary: Join Theo Dorsey as he explores the amazing equestrian scene in Palm Beach County, Florida. Get ready for some horseplay, Palm Beaches style!

name: BBC News at 8am
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: BBC News at 11.45am
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: Shinjuku Yasen Byoin
summary:
There is an old but special hospital in the Kabukicho district of Shinjuku, Tokyo. Because of the surrounding entertainment district, the hospital receives people who are different from the average Japanese person. The patients that visit the hospital include homeless people, foreign residents, hosts, and sex workers. 

One day, a mysterious woman named Nishi Freeman Yoko appears at the hospital. She is a doctor with U.S. citizenship and military medical experience in the U.S. She begins to work at the hospital and becomes a presence that brightens up everything around her. Meanwhile, Takamine Toru is a beauty dermatologist, but he studies anesthesia at his uncle's hospital, where Nishi Freeman Yoko begins to work. Takamine Toru dreams of remodelling his uncle's hospital and opening a cosmetic surgery hospital, but after he meets Nishi Freeman Yoko, his life changes.

name: Per Elisa - Il caso Claps
summary: Elisa leaves to go to mass on a sunny Sunday in September 1993. From that day she disappears until her body is found, 17 years later, in the attic of a church.

name: BBC News at 11am
summary: The latest news from the BBC.

name: For the Young Ones
summary: The newly appointed Director of the Juvenile Prosecution Department, Lei Xu (played by Zhang Yi), along with juvenile prosecutor Du Ziyu (played by Qin Lan), clerk Yang Tian (played by Xu Fan), and bailiff Xu Zhangli (played by Wang Zhen'er), and other members of the Ninth Prosecution Department, are handling juvenile criminal cases when a case suddenly takes a dramatic turn. At the same time, a juvenile suspect in an accidental death case also comes to their attention. Several seemingly unrelated cases are found to be intricately connected, and the prosecutors of the Ninth Prosecution Department uncover the truth behind the cases step by step, bringing the criminals to justice. They work together to protect the youth, nurturing the future with love, hoping for the day when there will be no more cases to handle.

name: Пока не родила
summary: 18-year-old Kira, trying to save her family from eviction from the apartment, comes up with a scam, which she herself becomes a victim of. At the IVF clinic, she is given an embryo of a wealthy childless married couple intended for their surrogate mother. Kira's plan was to blame the clinic for the mistake and get the money, but now she faces a dilemma — to get rid of an unwanted pregnancy? But then she would deprive people of the last chance to have a long-awaited child. Or give birth? It means saying goodbye to your usual life, your dream of becoming an artist and freedom, which means so much to Kira. The girl's greedy mother sees her pregnancy as an excellent source of income, and the rich couple seeks to control Kira in everything and imposes their terms of the "contract".

name: People Magazine Presents: Crimes of the 2000s
summary: People Magazine goes beyond the headlines by walking through each year of the 2000s to put a spotlight on the most intriguing and chilling crimes of the decade.

name: People Magazine Presents: Crimes of the '90s
summary: Over the course of ten gripping episodes, People Magazine will take viewers through each year of the 1990s highlighting the most intriguing and chilling crimes of the decade.

name: Thong Prakai Saed
summary: The story is about Thong Prakai or Thong Dee, a girl who went to live in Bangkok in search for a better life. She gets envolved with several men, using them as a ladder to become rich and luxurious.

name: Los Borbones: una familia real
summary: A unique and unprecedented look, with images and testimonies of great impact and public interest, into the recent history of the Spanish Royal Family.

previousepisode.name: Los Borbones y otras casas reales

name: Look Mai Lark See
summary: New generation of young life It is a product of the family institution's colorful lace. These products will make society bright or dull. It all depends on the cultivator. That will make these trees take root and stand strong to weather the storms of life today and in the future.

name: Он просто чудо
summary: Kostya is an unusual, charming guy who doesn't know much about the world. Lyokha is a street artist who thinks he has understood everything about this life. The friendship between them is pure chance. But it is this chance that will turn their ideas about everything upside down. Every day, Kostya and Lyokha will discover new facets to each other and those around them.

name: Бывшие 2.0
summary:
Reality about those who are ready to give their ex-partner a second chance. In this project, you will see heroes who once decided to break up with their "other halves", but over time wanted to return the relationship.

They will meet with their exes and try to start everything from scratch, but will they be able to avoid the same old rake?

name: ОПГ
summary: "OPG" is a good comedy about how it's never too late to change and change the world for the better. The series' main character is a provincial bandit nicknamed Vorkuta, who lived by the motto from "Boomer": "It's not us who are like that - it's life." But the "dashing 90s" ended, and he got a prison term. In 2024, the hero is released, where he will have to make amends to those whose lives he ruined. Vorkuta turns to his former accomplices for help, who were never able to find themselves in a new life. The Socially Useful Group enthusiastically embarks on the path of correction and begins to help the townspeople.

name: Никто не знает про Маньпупунёр
summary: Nikita works in a video store and dreams of becoming a director. But a fatal diagnosis ruins his plans for life. Realizing that there is almost no time, he decides to fulfill an old school dream — to walk through the wild taiga with his classmates to the mystical Manpupuner plateau and make his first and possibly last film about it. Four friends find themselves in wild places where people disappear and poachers rule. But the further they go through the sharp rocks and stormy rivers, the more clearly they realize that each of them must pass the real test inside themselves.

name: Eternally Yours
summary: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

name: DMV
summary: DMV is set at the place everyone dreads going most: the DMV. Our quirky and lovable characters are making minimum wage, doing a thankless job where customers are annoyed before they even walk in the door. Good thing they have each other.

name: Billy, le Hamster Cowboy
summary: Growing up in the Wild West and raised on the exciting stories told by his father, Billy with his cowboy outfit has a burning desire to hit the trail! And since every new day presents him with an opportunity to go on an adventure worthy of the greatest cowboys, he is determined not to miss out… He takes with him his faithful friend Jean-Claude the worm, and his accomplice Suzie, the stone marten, and off they go!

name: Sociedade Recreativa
summary: Topical magazine, with Sílvia Alberto did not command the central interview. With reporters Rita De La Rochezoire, Teresa Peres and Jani Gabriel.

name: Kentucky Jones
summary: Series set against the background of thoroughbred horse racing. Dennis Weaver stars in title role. Kentucky Jones is a veterinarian and former horse trainer. Rickey Der is Dwight Eisenhower Wong, and Harry Morgan plays sidekick, Seldom Jackson. Jones emerges as a contemporary man, a former horse trainer and veterinarian, whose interest is horse racing and whose life is complicated by a foster son, Dwight, a 9-year-old Chinese orphan.

name: Max Verstappen - Off the Beaten Track
summary: Three captivating episodes reveal the hidden side of Max Verstappen not captured by other cameras. Each episode highlights a different aspect of Verstappen's passion beyond the F1 circuit.

name: Pak Boong Kub Goong Nang
summary: Pak Boong and Goong Nang are two people who look alike but have different personalities. Pak Boong was born into a poor family and her mother is kind of abusive. While Goong Nang was born into a rich family. Pak Boong also knows how to fight or do Muay thai, and knows how to protect herself, while Goong Nang is the weak one. One day, they meet and decide to switch places with each other.

name: Primetime in Paris: The Olympics
summary: Experience the full flavor of the Olympics, as the world's greatest athletes go for gold with the majestic landmarks of Paris as the spectacular backdrop. With the biggest stars and stories, surprise celebrities and special behind the scenes access.

name: I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History
summary: Alicia is the eldest daughter of the noble Williams family—a bloodline that excels in dark magic. Her jet-black hair and golden eyes command a powerful presence, but her most unique features are, without a doubt, her sharp tongue and malevolent nature. By all means, she is a villainess, but also a fictional character from an otome game! As an ardent admirer of Alicia, a young, unnamed woman wishes to be her. Fortunately, a sleepy truck driver grants her wish in a bizarre twist of events—killing and consequently reincarnating her as a seven-year-old Alicia inside the game. With sufficient knowledge of how the game plays out, "Alicia" is confident that she will go down as the greatest villainess in history as long as she endeavors to work hard. However, she soon begins to realize that escaping Alicia's fate is not so simple as it seemed.

name: 60 Day Hustle
summary: In this high-stakes competition series, twelve determined entrepreneurs are thrust into the ultimate business accelerator challenge. We condense two years of business fundamentals into an intense 60-day showdown. These aspiring moguls will battle it out to demonstrate their knack for success and claim the cash prize that could transform their business dreams into reality.

name: Voetbalouders
summary: When the parents of a youth football team turn out to be more competitive than their kids, their antics on the sidelines soak up all the attention.

name: Hurling for Cancer Research
summary: Founded in 2011 by racing legends Jim Bolger and Davy Russell, live coverage of the annual charity game.

name: Tour de France na mBan: Súil Siar
summary: Sporting highlights from the annual race.

previousepisode.name: 18/08/2024: Stage 8 - Le Grand-Bornand to Alpe d'Huez

name: Dus June Kii Raat
summary: The entertaining potboiler follows the extraordinary chronicles of Panauti ‘Bhagyesh', a man whose reputation for bad luck is so notorious that residents of Raniganj would rather stay home than cross paths with him. Panauti's only dream is to reopen the infamous Menka theatre and restore his father's legacy. His journey is packed with unexpected, uproarious twists and turns, plunging him into one outrageous predicament after another. With a cast of colourful characters and laugh-out-loud misadventures, Panauti and his cousin Battu's quest for love and luck is a rollercoaster of hilarity and heart that will leave audiences in splits and on the edge of their seats.

name: Shekhar Home
summary: Set in 1990s Lonpur, Bengal, Shekhar Home combines suspense & comedy as eccentric Shekhar and his new housemate Jayavrat solve a variety of cases while interacting with a vibrant cast of characters in a charming, pre-technology era.

name: Fashion Forward
summary: Fashion Forward is a weekly series that gives you an inside look into the glamorous world of the most stylish stars. Keep up with the latest news, check out what the most influential models are up to on social media, get to know their beauty secrets and learn how to dress like your favourite celebs.

name: Star Tunez
summary: Star Tunez is a weekly music series that brings viewers the very latest news, gossip, releases and chart rundowns from around the world. It looks into the lives of the music industry's hottest artists and discovers what it's like to live your life on stage. From glamorous award ceremonies to show-stopping performances to how artists use social media, Star Tunez reveals the private moments of the music world's biggest stars as well as some quickly rising newcomers.

name: Любопытная Варвара
summary: The plot centers on a smart and well-read girl named Varvara, who comes to the village of Verkhovoye for summer holidays. There she meets a brave and slightly naive boy Vasya, who becomes her faithful companion in the investigation of mysterious incidents. First of all, the children will have to deal with a mysterious scarecrow that comes to life every night and scares the locals. But this is just the beginning of the exciting and fun adventures that await young detectives in a quiet village.

name: ThreeNews
summary:
ThreeNews is the next generation of Newshub, which was closed by Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) on July 5, 2024.

WBD entered a partnership with Stuff to produce a new 6pm bulletin.

Sam Hayes presents the one-hour weekday bulletin, alongside Stuff's national newsroom and top journalists including Jenna Lynch, Laura Tupou, Ollie Ritchie, Juliet Speedy, Heather Keats and Lisette Reymer.

name: Patrick Gower: On Ice
summary: In this two part special, Patrick travels to Antarctica to look at the issue threatening to wipe us out: The Climate Crisis and asks what can we do about it?

name: Paris 2024: The Daily Wrap
summary: Tune in for the daily Breakfast Wrap where we bring you all the latest highlights from last night at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.

name: Расследование с Аидой Мартиросян
summary: This program has no script and no invited participants, only real people who turn to a psychic in a difficult life situation. Aida Martirosyan will try to help people who have lost hope and need support.

name: The Secret Lives of Our Urban Birds
summary: A Catalyst series. Nature journalist and self-confessed bird-nerd, Dr Ann Jones, heads out on an urban safari through Sydney, Brisbane and Melbourne to uncover the secret lives of the city's feathery friends.

name: American Murder: Laci Peterson
summary: In this riveting true-crime docuseries, loved ones, experts and jurors revisit Laci Peterson's disappearance and the ensuing murder investigation.

name: Karen Kingsbury's A Thousand Tomorrows
summary: From NYT best-selling author Karen Kingsbury, only God knows how many tomorrows we have left. In the dangerous and competitive rodeo world, how will Cody and Ali make the most of their time together?

name: Riley Rocket
summary: Crank up the volume with Megablast! These super sonic heroes save the day with the power of music.

name: Love & Bid Farewell
summary: Five years ago, a treasonous conspiracy wiped out Gu Junyao's entire family. She dedicated herself to a shadowy organization, enduring years of hardships just for revenge. Prince Yue Jinchen was the perfect weapon for her vengeance. Yet, what appeared to be an ethereal prince was, in truth, a master of manipulation—each calculated step only led him to become a pawn. Now, caught between the blaze of desire and the treacherous dangers of the imperial palace, where will her path take her?

name: Desert Whispers
summary: The story follows the orphans, Gu Dan and He Dongliang, who are coerced into stealing the ancient Western Xia artifact, the Wondrous Sound Bird, in order to rescue their abducted mentor, Liu Buchang. Meanwhile, the security team captain Qiao Yu and the insurance investigator in charge of the claims, Yu Xiaoxiao, become entangled in this treasure theft case. Together, they join forces to unravel a shocking conspiracy by an international tomb-robbing syndicate to seize the nation's treasures.

name: The Power Couple
summary: Instead of fighting crime, superhero couple Gaby and Vince can't stop fighting each other. Before they can save the day, they must see if they can save their marriage in couples therapy.

name: Line Up
summary: Line Up is a talk show in a barbershop. The place where the heist stories and honest conversation live – all while getting a fresh haircut. A talk show that makes room for inspiring guests and the voices of minorities.

summary: We look at some of the big issues facing teens today in Australia.

name: Play School Science Time
summary: Science has never been more easy and fun with Play School Science Time! Discover your own way at home with Luke and Rachael as they use household items to investigate and create DIY science experiments.

name: Open Season: Call of Nature
summary: When Boog and Elliot discover an abandoned Summer Camp in the middle of nowhere, they embark on a brave new adventure of creating a safe and special place to live that welcomes animals of every kind.

name: GG: Spawn Squad
summary: GG: Spawn Squad shines a spotlight on the most amazing young Aussie gamers and content creators. In each episode, a different member of the Spawn Squad is joined by a special guest for an epic gaming sesh!

name: Australia's Extinct Megafauna
summary: Meet some of Australia's larger-than-life prehistoric giants in this animated series about megafauna, narrated by comedian Sammy J.

name: Born Evil: The Serial Killer and the Savior
summary: Born Evil: The Serial Killer and the Savior featuring a deep dive into the actions of Hadden Clark, a lesser-known serial killer, Born Evil explores his life and crimes.

name: Salmond and Sturgeon: A Troubled Union
summary:
Salmond and Sturgeon: A Troubled Union, features new and extensive interviews with both former First Ministers who tell the inside stories of key moments during a period of unprecedented electoral success for the Scottish National Party.

A wide range of prominent figures share their insights into the party's journey from the isolation of the pre-devolution years into an era when it returned MPs in significant numbers to Westminster and gained control of the Scottish Parliament.

name: Keats
summary: Keats follows Alex Keats, a fourth-generation police officer who walked away from the badge and her family, who returns to Philadelphia to bury her mother. Mom is a decorated officer who supposedly died by suicide. The closer Alex gets to discovering the truth about her mother's death, the closer she gets to joining her family back on the force … where she belongs.

name: South Aussie with Cosi
summary:
Cosi is a proud, born and bred South Australian who heads up South Aussie with Cosi. Since first airing in 2011, South Aussie with Cosi has fast become South Australia's favourite travel lifestyle show.

Cosi is SA's biggest producer of TV in the state and very proud to employ only South Australians! South Aussie with Cosi is a household name, not only showcasing regional and city travel destinations but also promoting SA business, local lifestyle, well-being, community spirit, state history and everything in between!

name: Discover
summary: Kelly Golding hosts a weekly journey of discovery, exploring travel, food, home and money.

name: Weekender
summary: Whether it's day-tripping to the reef, watching a fiery outback sunset, or brunch at a cool city cafe, WEEKENDER will inspire you to make the most of your precious break.

name: AFL Friday Night Countdown
summary: Friday Night Countdown gives footy fans the perfect lead-in to the weekend's round of footy.

name: The 4wd Adventure Show
summary: Ticking off bucket-list adventures is what life is all about for our adventurers!

name: Aussie Adventure Bike Show
summary: Two long time bike-nut mates who have been riding dirt and road bikes for most of their lives decide to join the growing ranks of riders packing up and heading out on the adventure bike trail.

name: Search4hurt
summary: TV's most savage social experiment returns as Search4Hurt starts its mission to find the fittest everyday Aussies to join their hybrid sporting team.

name: National Drag Racing Competition
summary: The National Drag Racing Championship delivers the 11,000hp fire-breathing spectacle of Top Fuel and Nitro Funny Car together with Top Doorslammer, Pro Alcohol, Pro Stock, Top Fuel Motorcycle, Pro Mod, and more!

name: Tackling Australia
summary: Are you ready to embark on an epic adventure across Australia? Meet Nige and Nicko: journalists, tournament anglers, fishing guides, and experts in all things 'fishy'.

name: Today In Paris
summary: Sarah Abo and Karl Stefanovic bring you highlights, replays and special guests Live from the Trocadero studio.

name: 9news Morning Weekend
summary: Join 9News for up to the minute news on local and international news including sport and weather.

name: The Crocodile Hunter Diaries
summary: The Crocodile Hunter Diaries is a wildlife documentary television series first aired on cable TV channel Animal Planet. It was created as a spin-off to the original The Crocodile Hunter series hosted by Australian naturalist Steve Irwin and his wife Terri Irwin. In the UK it was aired on ITV. In Australia, it was aired on Network Ten. The show is more focused around the everyday lives of Steve, Terri, and the employees of Australia Zoo. The first season (filmed in 1998 and aired in 2002) covered, among other things, Terri's pregnancy with her and Steve's first child Bindi, medical problems with Steve's dog Sui, the construction of the Crocoseum, daily ups and downs experienced by zoo staff on the job and animal rescue adventures.

name: Jo Brand's Big Splash
summary: Comedian Jo Brand combines stand-up comedy with various tasks involving water.

name: Porridge: Inside Out
summary: This documentary looks at the history behind the iconic British sitcom, Porridge, and the legacy it created. It includes looking at the Christmas specials and the spin-off series, Going Straight.

name: Sitcom Does...
summary: Gold presents this documentary that looks at how different British sitcoms used the themes of family, romance, friends and Christmas.

name: Nrlw Wrap
summary: Join Emma Lawrence, Ruan Sims, Allana Ferguson and Marlee Silva for all the latest news from the NRLW.

name: The Labours of Erica
summary: Erica Parsons is just about to turn 40. She has decided to set herself 12 tasks to complete before she reaches this milestone.

previousepisode.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

name: Lee Nelson's Well Funny People
summary: Lee Nelson's back with some old and new friends. Quality!

name: SKY Castle
summary: Asami Sae is a housewife, married to a doctor, and has two daughters. Her family lives within the exclusive SKY CASTLE neighborhood. She works hard to get her eldest daughter into the most prestigious high school, and she will do anything to accomplish that goal. Her neighbors in SKY CASTLE include Minamisawa Izumi, Nikaido Kyoko, and Natsume Misaki. All of these women try to send their children to the same elite high school. They hear that the son of their neighbor, Saejima Kaori, has passed the entrance exam to the high school that they desperately want their children to attend. They are eager to hear from Saejima Kaori on what was used to help her son pass the exam. Saejima Kaori reveals the existence of exam coordinator Kujo Ayaka. Kujo Ayaka only tutors two students a year and charges an extraordinary fee, but she gets her students into any school that they want. She boasts a 100% success rate.

previousepisode.name: The Shocking Truth - Unmasking the True Culprit!

name: Campus Beats
summary: What starts as an agenda to get closure for her past , a GenZ girl uncovers her hidden dancing talent and in the process experiences the real meaning of friendship, love, freedom and justice in a modern dance academy divided sharply across socio-economic class.

name: Blue Ribbon Baking Championship
summary: Blue ribbon-winning bakers from state fairs across the US face off for the first time in an epic baking showdown to win top honors and $100,000.

name: Live: NRL Saturday Night Footy
summary: Live footy coverage on Nine.

name: Live: NRL Women's Premiership
summary: Live coverage of the NRL Women's Premiership.

name: Perfect Murder, Perfect Town: JonBenét and the City of Boulder
summary: About the infamous murder of six year old child beauty pageant contestant JonBenét Ramsey and the hysterical media coverage that made the investigation even more difficult.

name: Live: Test Rugby - Wallabies V Springboks
summary: Live coverage of Test Rugby matches.

name: Live: Test Rugby Post-Game
summary: All the post game analysis of test rugby matches.

name: 10's Late News
summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

name: Pooches at Play
summary:
Pooches at Play is a Lifestyle TV Show all about dogs and our relationship with them, tips and advice for training and looking after your dog, produced and hosted by dog trainer and animal welfare advocate, Lara Shannon, with her cheeky side-kick Dynamite Darcy firmly by her side.  

In Series 4 Lara was joined by travel presenter Morgan Burrett for a pet-friendly travel adventure, with resident vet, Dr Melissa Meehan continuing to provide her health and safety tips for pet owners.  

In Series 1 – 3 saw Australian Actor, Gyton Grantley, joined Lara as they explored life on four legs.

name: 10 News: Lunchtime
summary: Comprehensive coverage of local, national and international news. Plus, all the latest sport and weather.

name: Chute!
summary:
Imagine going on a guided tour of BBC Television Centre, where you're shown round the studios, the Blue Peter garden and even the place where the rubbish goes. But then you accidentally fall down a chute and end up in one of the BBC's tips, where you meet Ross Lee, who's also trapped down there.

But it's not that bad! The place is full of videotapes with hilarious clips from old TV series, outtakes and other silly stuff! There are even pilots of shows that never made it on air!

There are guest occasionally visiting Ross, like CBBC's Raven, Bill Oddie, or a pair of Saturday morning numpties! But look out for the Monster though!

name: Laugh??? I Nearly Paid My Licence Fee
summary: Comedy sketch series, derived from A Kick Up the Eighties.

name: Deal or No Deal: Celebrity Jackpot
summary:
Deal or No Deal is set to return to Australian screens with a celebrity twist. Starting Monday, 22 July 2024, at 7.30 pm on 10 and 10 Play, six celebrity jackpot specials will see well-known names take on the Banker.

Host Grant Denyer will be joined by Gold Logie-winning comedian Tom Gleeson, MasterChef Australia judges Andy Allen and Sofia Levin, the stars of Gogglebox Australia, Collingwood Premiership captain Darcy Moore, Matildas champion Kyah Simon, and I'm A Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here! winner Skye Wheatley.

The celebrities will be aiming to win $250,000 for their chosen charities, adding a feel-good twist to the high-stakes, high-tension format.

name: Verano del 98
summary: A group of friends, a campfire, a wish, and a reunion that will change their lives forever.

name: Tough Tested
summary: Tough Tested is a new TV Show designed to ‘tough test' similar products in practical but challenging conditions.

name: Have I Got News for You
summary: Have I Got News for You is the comedy panel show which delivers comic observations from the satirical to the surreal through the lens of a news quiz show. An institution in Britain, this an award-winning comedy series is now invading America! Always relevant and topical, the series serves up a smart, silly, opinionated, and edgy take on the news of the week featuring a rotating collection of comedians, pundits, politicos, and entertainers. It features host Roy Wood Jr. along with two illustrious team captains Amber Ruffin and Michael Ian Black to guide the guests through an array of games and quick-witted panel conversations that test their knowledge of current events.

name: Hidden Histories of WWII
summary:
Internationally renowned historian and broadcaster, James Holland, takes a deep dive into key events from the Second World War, bringing incredible stories to life for a new generation, and offering new research and analysis to enhance our understanding of the most consequential war of the 20th Century.

Each episode follows Holland buddying up with a fellow expert companion to explore the locations, characters and hardware that bring each story to life. Holland and his guests travel to Lyon to learn about the downfall of the French Resistance leader, Jean Moulin; to Rauray to follow an epic tank battle; to Monte Cassino in the footsteps of the incredible Polish forces, and across the UK to explore how the development of a single aircraft contributed to making possible the D-Day landings.

On location, we get a sense of how each story played out, alongside Holland's re-telling, and the interpretation of its importance and impact as he analyses each event with his companion, illustrated with archive imagery, records and animated sequences.

previousepisode.name: Tiger Vs Sherman: Tank Action At Rauray

name: Blue Canvas of Youthful Days
summary: Qi Lu who comes from a family of artists, was forced to learn painting from a young age under his father's controlling influence. In his senior year of high school, due to a misunderstanding, he decides to study in Liu Ming Yang's studio. There, he meets Qin Xiao, a village boy living in the city, and a talented painter burdened by family responsibilities. Qin Xiao turns out to be the online artist "Lan" (Blue) whom Qi Lu has been searching for. Feeling guilty towards Lan, Qi Lu struggles to muster the courage to confess his secret to the seemingly irritable Qin Xiao. Instead, he approaches Qin Xiao with the hope of becoming friends. As they break the ice and grow closer, Qi Lu becomes increasingly moved by Qin Xiao's resilience and starts to have different expectations for their relationship...

name: Dear Hyeri
summary:
Ju Eun-ho is an unknown announcer with 14 years of experience. She struggles to get the chance to have her name recognized by the public. She also has another personality, Ju Hae-ri, due to a deep wound in her heart. Her alter-ego, Ju Hae-ri, is super positive and works as a parking attendant.

 

Jeong Hyun-oh is Ju Eun-ho's ex-boyfriend; they dated for a long time but broke up. He became a star announcer as soon as he joined the broadcasting station and is the most-liked announcer by the public, but Jeong Hyun-oh also carries a hidden wound in his mind that he has never shown to anyone. Somehow, Ju Eun-ho and Jeong Hyun-oh reunite and help cure each other's wounds.

name: Breakthrough: Women Changing the Game
summary: Breakthrough: Women Changing the Game follows a diverse group of female athletes through make-or-break seasons in traditionally male-dominated sports.

name: Tempest
summary: A former diplomat uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the stability of the Korean Peninsula.

name: The Secret World of Children
summary:
In today's world, kids are given far less freedom and independence than in previous generations.

In this provocative, surprising and entertaining two-part series, we take a diverse range of nine and ten-year-olds, all from different walks of life, and give them their first taste of adult life.

Grouped in three, and with their parents watching apprehensively from a secret location, we see how the children react to their newly found independence in the big bad world. Across each episode, the children are placed in challenging scenarios that test their common sense, their ability to think for themselves, recognise danger and act independently, while their parents watch on, in both shock and delight.

name: Harry & Meghan: The Rise & Fall
summary: A look at the Duke and Duchess of Sussex's relationship, a love story that captured the imagination of the world and changed the royal family for ever.

name: Warship: Life in the Royal Navy
summary: JJ Chalmers and Kate Humble are given unprecedented access to the Royal Navy, both at sea and across many of their establishments back home. Our cameras are on board as a British warship hunts down a Russian submarine; Kate gets special clearance to go behind the scenes at Britian's secretive submarine base at Faslane in Scotland and JJ reveals what it takes to be an elite Royal Marine Commando as he journeys back to the beginning of his military career.

name: Michael Mosley: Wonders of the Human Body
summary: Michael Mosley takes us on extraordinary journey around the human body. Michael puts his body to the test to help you at home understand yours, as he tracks down answers to lots of burning questions, such as; Why do we get creaky joints? What happens when we catch the flu? Can we help our brains stay fit as we age? How do doctors replace a hip? We meet people from around the country with stories to share that shed light on the hidden marvels of our bodies.

name: Rescue 999: Seconds to Save a Life
summary:
Rescue 999: Seconds to Save a Life is an exciting new series with a unique viewpoint of dramatic real-life rescues. Working with UK rescue teams covering sea, mountain, land and air, body-cam material of real-life incidents take the viewer to the heart of the action. The heroic Rescuers and distressed casualties re-tell the story from both sides of the drama as we follow an unfolding narrative of the rescue from start to finish.

Each episode features emotionally charged, real-life emergencies from all over the UK, unpicking the series of events leading to rescuing people in the most perilous of situations. The series celebrates brilliant men and women putting their lives on the line for strangers in need.

name: Forensics: Murder Scene
summary:
Forensics: Murder Scene is a groundbreaking observational documentary series which takes the viewer behind the blue police tapes at the crime scene. It tells the inside story of how the expert Forensic teams work alongside West Yorkshire Police to solve and prosecute murders, on the scene as soon as the crime is reported. 

With unprecedented access to both teams, cameras follow the crime from the 999 call, tracking the work of scientists, forensic experts and Major Crime Team detectives to piece all the evidence together for prosecution.

We go inside the murder scene itself, see the evidence as it's discovered in the critical hours after the events take place. More compelling than a drama, more real than any other factual series, new high-end technology combined with expertise and knowledge, provides a definitive look into the world of CSI, where no stone is unturned, and every death literally leaves a deadly trace.

name: Kindergarten: The Musical
summary: Kindergarten: The Musical is an animated musical series about navigating all of the "firsts" young kids experience while attending kindergarten. Whether having your own set of school supplies for the first time, finding a place to sit in the lunchroom or making a new friend, kindergartners can feel so many feelings that are sometimes hard to express with just words; singing about it feels more comforting and expressive. The series follows 5-year-old Berti Benavente, who, with the help of her amazing teacher and new friends, uses her imagination to express her fears, excitement and joy through big Broadway-style song and dance numbers, proving that kindergarten is just like a big stage and there is nothing a good song can't fix.

name: We Might Regret This
summary: A fresh relationship, a family, an intense female friendship. Tetraplegic artist Freya asks her chaotic best friend Jo to be her carer in her new home: her partner Abe's house.

name: The Challenge Sverige
summary: The Challenge combines competition with reality in a format where participants are pitted against each other in a series of tough and often dangerous competitions.

name: The Tragically Hip: No Dress Rehearsal
summary: A love story between a band and and the country they call home. Canadian rock'n'roll legends The Tragically Hip share the story of their unique, complicated and wildly successful musical brotherhood. 40-years of hits and misses, friendship and frustration, triumph and tragedy. Featuring never-before-seen performances, unreleased music and unprecedented access to The Hip.

name: House of Ali
summary: Step inside the electric world of luxury home designer Ali Budd as she pulls back the curtain to reveal the décor and drama behind the million-dollar renovations that have put her on the map, from single-room edits to whole-home builds.

name: Iliza's Locals
summary: Iliza Shlesinger's Iliza's Locals is a three part comedy special featuring the best up-and-coming comics in Los Angeles.

name: Second-Hand Showdown with Vicky Pattison
summary: Vicky Pattison helps guests to find a bold new style using only pre-loved fashion. Two stylists pull together the looks, but only one wardrobe will win. Who'll triumph in the second-hand showdown?

name: Whatever Happened to Huey Lewis
summary: Whatever Happened to Huey Lewis follows rock and roll legend Huey Lewis as he navigates his new life after losing his hearing. With the help of his codependent family and eccentric celebrity friends, Huey will tackle this hilarious next phase with his signature Heart and Soul.

name: Dublin Horse Show
summary: Ruby Walsh presents live coverage from the RDS including the Nations Cup

name: Espías del Amor
summary: The TV show presents us stories of people looking for love on the Internet. Many of them have quite long relationships, but have never seen the other person in the flesh. The mission of the spies is to be able to bring couples together, but they could come across identities that are real, with others that are lies or people who have more than something to hide.

name: Nadie nos va a extrañar
summary: It's the '90s, and five losers run an illegal business at their high school. They sell homework and assignments to their classmates. The advantage is that no one ever suspects the nerds. Their business brings them money and popularity. But hormones and an unexpected death threaten to ruin everything. If the business collapses, their futures and their friendships are at risk.

name: Veckan med Camilla och Leif GW
summary: Community program about crime, where Camilla Kvartoft and Leif GW Persson take on the hottest questions and forgotten cases, with sharp analyses, initiated conversations and exclusive guests.

name: Memoari porodice Milić
summary: A sitcom that follows the daily life of the Milić family in Sarajevo. Tanja is the youngest member of the household and writes a memoir about her family life. In a surreal twist, unknown to her family, Tanja is able to communicate with her pet goldfish Karolina to help solve different situations.

name: South Seas Spearo
summary: Follow a group of fanatical fin-addicts on their extreme spear-fishing expeditions. These top athletes dive beyond 100 feet, facing the dangers of the deep in pursuit of underwater adventures. It's action that will take your breath away!

name: Чистые руки
summary: Just yesterday they were students, the best of the best, the hope of Soviet physics. But today has come, and their talent is needed by Soviet intelligence. The year is 1980, the country is preparing to host the Olympic Games, and behind the facade of the big holiday is an escalating confrontation between the superpowers. And former friends, by the will of fate, find themselves on opposite sides of the barricades.

name: Ninja Hattori Returns
summary: When a mischievous young ninja named Hattori comes to live with slacker student Kenichi Mitsuba, they form a friendship and alliance against the bully Kemuzo Kemumaki and his wicked cat, Kagechiyo.

name: Danse!
summary: Marco, a hip-hop dancer who makes a living by teaching dance classes at his father's school. When the school is at risk of closing, Marco's entire life is on the verge of collapsing. Participating in FLOW becomes a golden opportunity for him to save the school while also achieving his dream...

name: Kuzgun: Dipsiz Karanlik
summary: Mehmet, a former police chief who rose rapidly in his career, has a talent that no one knows about. As the number of unsolved murder cases increases, Mehmet is offered consultancy with special powers

name: La collecte
summary: Before becoming a father, Kevin, a debt collector, decides to leave organised crime.

name: The Golden Cobra
summary: Ebbw Vale's best Indian takeaway... is not this one. With business saag-ing, can owner Basil and new delivery driver Nick take on their fierce rivals?

name: That Beryl Marston...!
summary: Georgie and Gerry Bodley's life was going well until he left her for Sussex sex strumpet Beryl Marston, but now he wants his ex-wife back.

name: Osmar, a Primeira Fatia do Pão de Forma
summary: Osmar is a slice of bread who is an eternal failure and optimist who tries to do everything he can to be someone important even though he is despised by everyone. He lives in a favored apartment with his friend Stevie, a loose and carefree baguette, and he is also in love with his beautiful neighbor Josie, a snob who never notices his existence and constantly ignores him.

name: Drink: A Look Inside the Glass
summary: An epic adventure into the stories of the world's most renowned alcohol producers. Each episode focuses on a single drink and its premier maker as they reveal the history, process, and craft that goes into every bottle.

previousepisode.name: Не за то отец сына бил

name: Numeracy in Sport
summary: Sports has more to do with mathematics than you might think. This series explores common scenarios in sport where it pays to be numerate. With real-life examples and clear demonstrations, it is an ideal tool to help students refresh their understanding of basic mathematical processes and computational thinking.

name: Changing States of Matter
summary: Matter can exist in three common states on Earth: solid, liquid and gas. This series explores how matter changes state and how we use matter in all states in our everyday lives. Excellent introductory viewing for students of science.

previousepisode.name: States of Matter All Around Us

name: Repco Supercars Highlights
summary: Who will finish their weekend at Sydney Motorsport Park on the top step of the podium in Race 16 of the 2024 Supercars Championship?

name: Happy of the End
summary: The penniless Chihiro sets his eyes on Keito at a bar hoping to leech off him, but things take a turn when during their hook-up he gets beaten up. What led to this situation happening? Living on the fringes of society, these two might start a new life together from their pain and hurt.

name: The On1y One
summary: Jiang Tian is a smart and solitary student living with his mother. His world changes when Sheng Wang, a popular and affluent new student, transfers to his school. The two begin a rivalry that only gets more complicated when Sheng Wang's father plans to marry Jiang Tian's mother. As step-brothers, they must confront their growing respect that transforms into forbidden attraction.

previousepisode.name: New Beginning: Pain is Necessary for Rebirth

name: Live: NRL Saturday Night Footy Post-match
summary: Join the Wide World of Sports team for the all the post-match NRL news and analysis.

name: Shute Shield
summary: Wide World of Sports presents the Charter Hall Shute Shield Qualifying Final.

name: BBQ High
summary: BBQ High Determined teens compete in Texas BBQ competitions as they navigate their senior year, make big life decisions and sharpen their culinary skills.

name: A Question of Sport: Super Saturday
summary: Sports-themed family entertainment show hosted by comedian Jason Manford. Super Saturday is packed full of fun, surprises, stunts and must-see challenges.

previousepisode.name: Pixie Lott, Adil Ray, Terry Alderton, Helen Skelton

name: Don't Quote Me
summary: Geoffrey Perkins hosts the television panel game where celebrities, comedians, politicians, academics, historians, journalists and more compete to work out who said what.

previousepisode.name: John Biffen, Roy Jenkins, Mark Lawson, Rory McGrath

name: Manchán's Europe By Train
summary: Manchán Magan embraces the ethos of slow travel, taking the time to get to know people and places, and experiencing local customs and traditions.

name: Ana de Nadie
summary: Ana makes the decision to separate from her unfaithful husband and give herself the opportunity to live new experiences.

previousepisode.name: La felicidad no tiene un final

name: Star Portraits with Rolf Harris
summary: Rolf Harris invites three professional artists to paint a celebrity.

name: Blø for drakta
summary: In this documentary series, we meet Kolstad Handball - a club with sky-high ambitions to become the friendly team that wins the Champions League. At the start of the 23/24 season, everything is ready for sporting success, but non-sporting problems are waiting.

name: You Want Me to Steal You
Matylda
summary: Opowieść historyczna o młodej kobiecie Matyldzie, która w trudnych politycznie czasach zaborów po Powstaniu Styczniowym staje się pionkiem intryg ziemiańskich. Jej przeszłość, która także dla niej samej jest tajemnicą, ciągnie się cieniem na politycznych decyzjach tak polskich patriotów, jak zdrajców knujących z rosyjskim zaborcą. Oprócz walorów edukacyjnych i historycznych serial zawiera bogate wątki sensacyjne i miłosne.

name: Country House Auction
summary: At Castle Durrow in the heart of Ireland, beautiful and extraordinary antique treasures are repaired, valued and bid for at this stunning country house auction.

name: The Prince and the Pauper
summary: A poor boy named Tom Canty and Edward, the Prince of Wales exchange identities but events force the pair to experience each other's lives as well.

name: Paul Merton's Palladium Story
summary: Two-part documentary in which Paul Merton tells the story of the famous London theatre, with contributions from those who worked there and a host of archive clips.

name: The Rose of Tralee International Festival
summary: Coverage of the annual competition.

name: Honey Lemon Soda
summary: After middle school, with its bullying and nicknames, Uka Ishimori is excited for a fresh start at Hachimitsu High School. Kai Miura, a cool and uninhibited boy, sits next to her in class. Uka remembers she met Kai in middle school and with a single word, he had convinced her to attend Hachimitsu. Though he's popular, Kai supports Uka in her efforts to fit in with her new classmates.

name: Una vida menos en Canarias
summary: Luis Lacasa, a prestigious homicide inspector in Madrid, is forced to accept a transfer to the Canary Islands and adapt to everything he hates: the heat, the sand and the tourists, but above all to Naira, a charismatic inspector, a lover of her land with whom, despite their differences and rivalries, he forms a good team and at the same time, a complicity that questions his ironclad beliefs.

previousepisode.name: Hasta que la muerte nos separe

name: Stewardessen
summary: Solving life's big problems requires the duration of a commercial flight. High in the air, stewardess Dagmar Croner (Johanna von Koczian) addresses the concerns of her passengers and colleagues and saves marriages, tracks down misdirected luggage, assists at a birth and helps a child of divorce to decide between father and mother. In between, she still has time to pass a test that will make her cabin boss. The passengers, but also the on-board staff, change from episode to episode. Monika Schloss (Isolde Miler), Alice Petaud (Evelyn Gressmann), Ilse Flemming (Monika Berg), Maria Gandlberger (Barbara Schöne) and Yukiko (Francisca Tu) appear several times. Herbert Tiede and Peter Carsten each played a flight captain in two episodes, but a different one each time.

name: She Behind, I Before
summary: Journalist Zhou Daizi goes missing while investigating the dark secrets of Qiansheng Entertainment Group. Her younger sister, Zhou Dailing, disguises herself as Daizi to continue the investigation and uncovers the illegal activities behind Qiansheng Entertainment. Together with detective Yu Pengliang, Zhou Dailing delves deeper into the case, discovering that Qiansheng Entertainment is merely a front for the K Group's mastermind. In the end, the K Group is dismantled, and the sisters are reunited.

name: Mid-Century Modern
summary: Mid-Century Modern follows three best friends - gay gentlemen of a certain age – who, after an unexpected death, decide to spend their golden years living together in Palm Springs where the wealthiest one lives with his mother. As a chosen family, they prove that no matter how hard things get, there's always someone around to remind you it would be better if you got your neck done.

name: Against The Odds
summary: Champions make winning look easy... it never is. Unique stories of perseverance and determination behind some of the most courageous and triumphant moments in world sport.

name: The Assembly
summary: Australia's most renowned interviewer, Leigh Sales, mentors Autistic journalism students as they learn their craft and interview well known Australian personalities.

name: The Ancient World
summary: The ancient world, from 60,000 BCE to 650 CE, is the period in which early civilisations emerged. This series gives a snapshot introduction to eight of these ancient societies, uncovering the features they had in common and how each of them were unique.

name: The Ancient to Modern World
summary: This series introduces five empires from 650 CE to 1750 and the connections between them, uncovering the beliefs and conflicts which formed the early foundations of the world we know today.

name: Circuit Boats Drivers Championship
summary: Boats running forced induction engines of up to 2000bhp, they're loud, fast and running five wide at over 200km/h, they're awe inspiring.

name: The Tailor of Sin City
summary: The Tailor of Sin City tells the story of a 1970s fashion icon turned drug kingpin caught between his loyalties to the Mob, the Colombian cartel, the FBI, and his 7 wives.

name: Beyond the Dream
summary: The Beyond the Dream series goes beyond the headlines to discover the untold stories that led to some of the greatest Olympic and Paralympic moments. With unprecedented access, this new documentary series will capture the raw spirit of some of the greatest athletes of all time.

name: 30 Years of The Footy Show
summary: Relive the iconic moments, untold stories, and never-before-seen footage from Australia's beloved AFL Footy Show. Featuring exclusive interviews, this special series is a must-watch for any AFL fan.

name: Ireland's Dirty Laundry
summary: For seven decades, the Irish State conspired with families, parishes and religious congregations to imprison and enslave over 10,000 Irish girls and women in the so-called Magdalene Laundries. After decades of silence, survivors of that system now share their experiences during and since their incarceration, and reveal how, even today, they are having to fight for the care, redress and acknowledgement that was promised to them.

name: Italy Artisans
summary: A poetic journey through the incomparable beauty of Italy's cities, which are told through the peculiar handcrafting skills known worldwide as Made in Italy.

name: Wan Jie Qi Yuan
summary: Lin Feng is an orphan who was adopted by Wu Village. One day he accidentally entered a forbidden land in the vicinity of Wu village where he found an ice coffin containing a beautiful woman. Ling Feng carelessly opened the ice coffin. The woman inside woke up and saw that Ling Feng was a special person of the demon race. She decided to help him, causing great physical changes in him. Since that day, many strange things began to happen in Wu village. With Ling Feng now having great power, how will he handle these situations?

name: The Story of Light Entertainment
summary: Stephen Fry narrates a series tracing the roots of light entertainment, from variety to Strictly Come Dancing and all points in between.

name: Celeb
summary:
Based on the strip cartoon featured in Private Eye, a fifty-something ageing rock star, deluded that he's still as famous, popular and successful as always.

Having once achieved worldwide stardom, the East End lad is now living it up in a large country manor just outside the picturesque village of Duntwich. With little to do most of the time, Gary spends his considerable wealth as only the nouveau riche can: on ostentatious decor, cars and home furnishings. And copious amounts of drugs - a habit he somehow manages to keep concealed from gorgeous current wife Debs, quite some years his junior and a former model.

Gary's twenty-something son, Troy, can be found by his side more often than not, whilst long-suffering butler Johnson despairs of his employer's lifestyle and demands.

name: Estate of Survival
summary: 8 Residents arrive for a competition at a luxury estate, only to find it completely empty. Greeted by Audra, their virtual host, they learn they must compete to earn essential appliances, furniture, and other necessities. After a challenging first day, tensions rise as several competitors form an alliance, leading to the strategic elimination of one Resident from the competition.

name: Zoofari
summary: Made up of hilarious live-action footage, Zoofari showcases the most adorable and incredible animals from around the world--from furry to feathered, scaly and more.

previousepisode.name: Halloween Costume Party, Pre-school of Fish

name: Penelope
summary: A restless teenager who questions her place in the world embarks on a soul-searching journey into the remote wilderness of the Pacific Northwest.

previousepisode.name: EP.36 | It's the Last Episode and They Are Telling Me to Go Up...

name: Murder By Medic
summary:
They know how to kill and how to cure. Inside a hospital, at home, or maybe even next door. They are trained to save lives but also know how to take them. This is Murder by Medic.
We are at our most vulnerable when ill, trusting our medics to care for us, to diagnose, to offer us treatment, to fix what's wrong. Our doctors and nurses are taught how to save lives but what happens when they decide to take lives instead? What happens when they don't cure us, what happens when they kill us?

This series tells the stories of 52 medics who have murdered their patients or used their medical know-how to kill closer to home.

From doctors to psychologists to dentists to nurses. Each episode delves into a different case examining the chilling true tales of medics who break the Hippocratic Oath and kill. The series pieces together the hard evidence, the means and the motive to create a full picture of the case. Told through poignant interviews with the loved ones of victims, key video and audio evidence, revelations from investigators and legal teams and insights from a distinguished panel of experts.

name: Accidente
summary: When a birthday party takes a tragic turn, its ripples shatter a close-knit community — tearing families, friendships and hearts apart.

name: Here Come the Irish
summary: Here Come the Irish documents life on and off the field of the legendary University of Notre Dame Fighting Irish football team through exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and interviews with those closest to the program.

name: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body
summary: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body is a new psychological true-crime thriller exploring the outlandish lengths diabolical killers have taken to get away with murder. Each horrifying episode reveals never before seen material and recounts in-depth tales of twisted criminal masterminds who go to great lengths and efforts to concoct plans to dispose of their victims. However, the unflinching tenacity and determination of the country's top detectives who are hellbent on solving these heinous crimes, bring to light these crimes and justice to those criminals who would have certainly gotten away with murder and been free to kill again.

name: The Real Murders on Elm Street
summary: The Real Murders on Elm Street is a chilling new documentary series about small suburban towns across America that have been torn apart by murder. At the heart of the series is the central question of how in a single night, these quaint residential ELM STREETS can descend from peace and tranquility into horror, senseless death, and tragedy. Each episode will examine a murder investigation that occurred on one of the many Elm Streets across America with each episode proving horror happens everywhere...

name: Cabin in the Woods
summary: In horror movies, nothing good ever happens to those in a Cabin in the Woods. In this series, true stories of ghastly, sometimes convoluted crimes take place in remote cabins around the country and for good reason: they allow those with evil intentions to carry out the most heinous of acts in peace and quiet away from prying eyes and ears. Combining hard-hitting investigative elements with spine-tingling thrills and chills, this true-crime-meets-true-horror series features the most terrifying crimes ever committed in isolated and otherwise picturesque cabin dwellings.

name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
summary: The scandalous world of a group of Mormon mom influencers implodes when they get caught in the midst of a swinging sex scandal that makes international headlines. Now, their sisterhood is shook to its core. Faith, friendship and reputations are all on the line. Will #MomTok be able to survive and continue to give the rulebook a run for its money, or will this group fall from grace?

name: Envidiosa
summary: After a devastating breakup, Vicky, almost 40, embarks on a quest for new love, unaware it will lead her to a profound—and hilarious—self-discovery.

name: My Aussie Build
summary: My Aussie Build takes audiences on the journey of the build. From its design inception to the reveal at the climax of each episode.

name: Debit Queen
summary: Ling Se, the eldest daughter of Ling Ji Cloth Shop, has always dreamed of leaving her family on her birthday to live a life of complete freedom where she doesn't have to marry or cater to others. However, her plans are thwarted when she unexpectedly encounters Xu Zilu, the wealthiest man in Linchun City. Not only does he outmaneuver her to acquire a shop she had long been eyeing, but he also deceives her into forming a contract marriage, binding them together against her will. Despite this, Ling Se's kind-hearted and independent nature and innovative business acumen gradually earn Xu Zilu's admiration, and he begins to develop feelings for her. As this pair of bickering yet fond "frenemies" continue their interactions, a hidden crisis within the Xu family begins to surface. The sudden appearance of a rival, Wu Qi, further complicates Xu Zilu's business and personal life. Fortunately, Ling Se's cleverness and entrepreneurial spirit led to the creating of a series of unique products. On their journey to the capital to resolve the family crisis, Ling Se and Xu Zilu grow closer, supporting and trusting each other more deeply. Together, they ultimately secure the prestigious title of Imperial Merchant and embark on a new commercial adventure in the capital.

name: Семейные игры. Битва за олимп
summary: In the fight for 3 million rubles, 18 families from all over Russia will go through 8 qualifying games, 3 semi-finals and a super final.

name: Красная Поляна
summary: Charming secular adventurer Sasha escapes from Moscow to Krasnaya Polyana, where she is attracted by the proximity of the sea and mountains, palm trees and snow, ambitious majors and reckless adventurers. In an attempt to settle in a new place and profit from relaxed vacationers, she immediately falls into the clutches of the head of the resort's security service, Mikhalych. To preserve her freedom, Sasha is forced to make friends with the hotel and casino staff and, becoming one of them, figure out the insidious blackmailers who force the manager to dance to their tune. She ran away from some problems in order to run into even bigger ones and eventually make the main choice of her life: freedom and financial independence or love and friends she never had.

name: Кто тут жулик?
summary: Five star guests meet at the gaming table, their task is to answer questions correctly and thereby earn money into the common pot. There is a cheater among them who got all the answers in advance. The presenter helps the players by giving them hints about the life of a mysterious fraudster. If the team does not find a "secret agent" in the final, that person takes all the earnings.

name: The Royals
summary: A young prince, astonishingly charming and unforgivably sexy with not a hint of shyness, was not expecting cupid to strike when he meets the prodigy girl who helms the leading startup of luxury homestays in India. Two worlds, one of a dwindling aristocracy, and the other of racing capitalism converge and throw up a whirlwind of clashing ambitions, steamy romance, chic couture and fashion-forward Instagrammable moments. This is a breezy zoomer romcom served up with a side of dreamy palace life, under the blazing royal sun.

name: The Assassin
summary: The Assassin centers on a merciless assassin known only as Victor, who after being betrayed by an anonymous client, finds himself hunted across the globe by multiple enemies, including relentless CIA operatives and a contract killer equally as deadly. To stay alive, Victor must uncover the identity of his betrayer while grappling with a buried spark of humanity that begins to resurface within him and might just be the greatest threat to his survival.

name: Шоу из Шоу
summary: In each episode improvisators parody six Russian shows at once, and the stars help them with it.

name: The Wranglers
summary: The Wranglers follows the personal and professional lives of young staff members working at the Circle Bar Dude Ranch in Montana.

name: Первые на деревне
summary: The project participants are used to living a glamorous life, which they are happy to share with millions of their subscribers. They can easily fly to Dubai by private jet for the weekend, drive around Moscow in expensive cars and eat in the most luxurious Michelin-starred restaurants. TNT decided to check what is behind these perfect pictures and whether those who are not used to serious work know their history, remember their roots and can take off their luxury masks to ground themselves and live the most honest and environmentally friendly life. The TV channel will send the stars of social networks to the village for re-education in order to bring them down from heaven to earth and show the real life of many people who earn their living by hard work and do not throw money down the drain. The unique format of the project was developed by the TV channel's team. The participants of the reality show are waiting for fun challenges, trials, which are everyday duties for ordinary villagers. The heroes of social networks are waiting for dirty work, which they have never faced before. Time will tell whether they will be able to avoid this dirt and remain the idols of the generation.

name: Виноград
summary: The story unfolds against the backdrop of the vineyards of the Krasnodar Territory, and the main character of the lyrical comedy turns out to be a man who is trying to restart his life in order to become happy again and return to his family. According to the plot, the Moscow top manager Egor Antonov has all the components of a successful life: a large position in a corporation, high earnings, a beloved family. He owes all this to his wife's father, who once took him under the wing of his company. The father-in-law does not like his son-in-law, but for the sake of his daughter and grandson he tolerates him in the family. One day, the main character starts an affair with an intern, which becomes known to his father-in-law. He immediately fires Egor and informs his daughter about his infidelity. In one second, a successful businessman loses everything: status, friends, family and access to your own card. Suddenly, fate presents him with a dubious gift - he becomes the owner of unprofitable vineyards in his native Anapa. Egor knows nothing about winemaking and returns to his homeland after 20 years. Here he has to start from scratch, figure out what he really wants in life, and return love.

With Florencia Peña and Benjamín Vicuña as hosts, they'll confront doubts, jealousy, and infidelities. Can the couples flirt with temptation without succumbing to it or will they be swayed by the exhilarating call of the forbidden?

summary: A proud knight, slain in battle, finds himself alive once more-reincarnated in the body of a fearsome behemoth. As if he wasn't confused enough by this turn of events, apparently behemoth cubs look exactly like adorable kittens?! Even if the rest of the world sees him as soft and cuddly, he has the honor of a noble warrior and the strength of an unstoppable S-ranked monster, both of which will be put to the test as he fights to protect the beautiful elf who has taken him as her pet!

summary: When Tom is widowed after 40 years of marriage, he is to be reluctantly looked after by his son and daughter in law. For 4 decades he has been suppressed by the will of a dominant woman - no smoking, no drinking or looking at other women. Now he is determined to live life to the full, while he has the time, but this causes friction in the household.
